answer: Rotating Shard Assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable random beacon shuffles agents into work shards; assignments stay sealed until the epoch opens, so identities cannot be pre-positioned where colluding clones would co-locate. An attacker must split across shards blind, like timber scattered by wind, losing collusion leverage. Any shard whose output correlates with one registrant's cluster triggers audit and forfeiture of that agent's escrowed execution capacity, a shale-like sunk cost per clone.
